commit.message:
test(ui): structural tests no longer race on the live theme table

The live theme (`theme::current()`, the process-wide `LIVE` cell in
theme.rs) is one table per test binary. The structural/snapshot tests
serialise on SNAPSHOT_LOCK, but `the_theme_door_switches_the_theme_and_
undo_restores_it` drives the real pick -> frame-edge sync path
(light, undo, redo, undo) without the lock, so a parallel run flipped
the table under shell_structure_light ("frame-edge sync rode the
world's reference") or shell_structure_dark (the dark-table assert).

Choice: serialise, not per-State. The table is process-wide by design
(one UI per process; ~44 read sites call `theme::current()` with no
State or Context in hand), so threading it per-harness would be a large
production change for a test-only race. The theme-door test now takes
the same snapshot_guard; the lock's doc names the rule for any future
test whose frames move the world's theme. No product behaviour change.

Fixes #605
